title: Arathi tribe
wikitext:
The '''Arathi''' were a tribe of humans who were able to unite the various tribes and found the nation of [[Arathor]] and its city-state capital of [[Strom]].<ref>[[Arathor and the Troll Wars]]</ref> The Arathi originates from rebels of the [[Azotha]] kingdom of [[Corthan]] fleeing north from their nation as they collapsed and reverted to a tribal state.<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1086439363199635568 Gheor from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] - "The Kingdom of Corthan predates the Arathor Empire. Corthan mentions rebels going up north of the now Badlands and implies they have gone back into a tribal state - thus being the first step towards the Empire of Arathor."</ref> 

Following the fracturing of that kingdom, the descendants of the original Arathi tribe travelled south to found the [[Stormwind (kingdom)|kingdom of Stormwind]].<ref>[[The Seven Kingdoms]]</ref> The last descendent of the Arathi bloodline was Sir [[Anduin Lothar]].
